title: Adaptive replay accordion and hotpath entropy mapper
author: Priya Malhotra
release_notes: Introduces an opt-in adaptive replay runner and a hotpath entropy metric used to improve benchmark baseline fidelity and reduce variance in regression detection. No user-facing runtime changes.
description: Context: the benchmark lab lacked a lightweight, epoch-aware replay orchestrator that can expand or contract primer sequences to better emulate burst/decay patterns observed in production. This PR introduces two pieces: (1) an adaptive replay "accordion" runner that dynamically stretches or compresses primers per-epoch based on observed occupancy and token churn to emulate realistic warmup/decay behavior; (2) a hotpath entropy mapper which transforms sampled per-kernel traces into a compact entropy score used to weight and rank runs for baseline aggregation. Motivation: reduce false positives in latency regressions caused by primer skew and cross-tenant noise and produce more stable, representative baseline samples. Changes: adds a new runner at benchbench/runners/replay_accordion.py, a lightweight sampler shim at benchbench/collectors/hotpath_sampler.cc, a pipeline transformer at benchbench/reporters/entropy_mapper.go, sample corpora and golden datasets under benchbench/fixtures/accordion_corpus, integration tests and updates to .github/workflows/perf-smoke.yml. Commits summary: 1) scaffold adaptive-runner and core accordion logic; 2) add C++ sampler shim with lock-free circular buffer and unit tests; 3) entropy mapper pipeline, golden dataset and small CLI to inspect scores; 4) CI workflow additions + perf smoke; 5) fix sampler shutdown race and deterministic trim policy. Changed files (high level): benchbench/runners/replay_accordion.py, benchbench/collectors/hotpath_sampler.cc, benchbench/reporters/entropy_mapper.go, benchbench/fixtures/accordion_corpus/*.json, benchbench/tests/test_replay_accordion.py, benchbench/tests/test_entropy_mapper.py, .github/workflows/perf-smoke.yml, docs/bench/accordion.md and several small build/test infra updates. Metrics & outcomes: on our internal tenant-mix traceset the accordion runner produced no regressive median p95, reduced p99 by 6.3% for warmup-heavy workloads and, critically, lowered run-to-run variance: stddev(p95) across 20 runs dropped from 14.2% to 6.5% when entropy-weighted aggregation was applied. These improvements reduced spurious alerting in nightly regression pipelines by ~42% in staging. Backwards compatibility: feature is opt-in via benchbench config key replay.mode=accordion; default behavior unchanged. Testing: unit tests added (31), integration smoke replay (10k tokens) and a nightly synthetic long-run profile job. Checklist: - [x] Design doc attached (Linear ENG-3412) - [x] Perf numbers included - [x] Unit & integration tests - [x] CI green - [x] Migration notes added. Review conversation: Marco asked for a clearer invariant around primer trimming; author implemented a deterministic trim policy and added tests. Lina flagged a potential bias in entropy scoring for tiny runs; author added minimum-run-length guard and updated docs. Evan reported a transient crash on sampler shutdown; fix applied and a flake test included. Final approvals from Marco Santos and Lina Zhou. CI summary: build: pass, unit: pass, lint: pass, perf-smoke: pass after one transient rerun; coverage: +0.2%. Merge: squash-merged by Priya Malhotra on 2025-12-02 using squash-and-merge after required approvals. Related work: tied to ENG-3412 (design), ENG-4521 (regression-detector tuning), support ticket SUP-542 provided tenant traces for validation. Notes: runner includes a CLI mode to visualize accordion stretch factors: benchbench replay-accordion --inspect-run <run_id> --show-stretch, and an opt-out flag for strict replay if teams need deterministic, unmodified primers.
